//@version=6
// Synthetic Pine source used as a test fixture.
// The real captured response contained a third-party author's full indicator, which
// is not redistributed here. Structure and metadata are unchanged.
indicator("Fixture Study", overlay = true)

length = input.int(20, "Length", minval = 1)
src    = input.source(close, "Source")

basis = ta.sma(src, length)
dev   = ta.stdev(src, length)

plot(basis, "Basis", color = color.blue)
plot(basis + dev, "Upper", color = color.green)
plot(basis - dev, "Lower", color = color.red)

alertcondition(ta.crossover(src, basis),  "Cross Up",   "Price crossed above basis")
alertcondition(ta.crossunder(src, basis), "Cross Down", "Price crossed below basis")
